latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: 事件动作触发失败 by @allenve in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11811
* fix: tree虚拟列表高度未重新计算 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11815
* fix: 表格编辑框-可复制按钮、快速编辑按钮等在非确认模式下换行 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11822
* 修复旧版事件动作异常 by @z418577198 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11823
* feat: 编辑拖拽组件支持容器自动滚动 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11829
* fix: crud双table情况下网格未对齐 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11832
* fix: 修复移动端可能拖入不了组件的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11835
* fix: 修复cards样式异常问题 by @qkiroc in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11834
* fix: 修复popOver组件内容字符过长时，弹窗中的内容闪烁 by @F-jianchao in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11836
* fix: loadDataOnceFetchOnFilter lose count by @thinkingc in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11828
* 更新快照 by @qkiroc in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11840
* fix: 修复弹窗复用可能出现弹窗丢失的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11843
* fix: tree虚拟列表加载接口时误将loading高度计算进来 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11844
* feat: crud2支持泛型，方便外围继承 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11846
* fix: 优化开启千分符后，带默认值的情况下，输入时小数末尾零被格式掉 by @F-jianchao in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11845
* fix: 修复 combo 组件可多选按钮关闭时最多条数&最少条数未被清空 by @Kerminate in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11853
* revert: 回滚fix:crud双table情况下网格未对齐 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11859
* [fix] picker组件禁用态样式 by @yangwei9012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11866
* fix: 修复子编辑器修改丢失问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11867
* chore: 调整全局变量更新机制使得组件层无须额外编写检测代码 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11865
* fix: form reset的时候父级数据也被还原 by @52flutter in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11860
* fix: 当表格列配置溢出显示 mapping等类型列显示出原始数据 by @52flutter in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11861
* feat: table 的列信息本地缓存支持配置 Close: #11850 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11855
* fix: 修复弹窗中 form 可能内容超出弹窗的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11869
* fix: 修复组件被事件动作隐藏后无法编辑的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11870
* fix: 删除元素错误优先用接口返回的错误信息 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11873
* fix: 修复 inputImage 从字符串回显时自动填充文件名逻辑空值的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11868
* fix: 补充国际化相关配置,补充语料 by @F-jianchao in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11874
* [fix] form组件的默认场景选择,在初始化加载schema时纠正一次 by @yangwei9012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11875
* fix: 元素样式的数值获取不精确 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11879
* fix: 修复 inputTable 合并单元格模式编辑态异常问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11881
* fix: 修复编辑器模式下 CRUD 会触发列保存的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11882
* feat: 动作面板schema配置支持函数 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11884
* fix: 双table边框无法对齐 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11895
* fix: 修复json请求时无法指定自定义的Content-Type by @lanyuanxiaoyao in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11889
* fix: 修复在无界框架中，弹出层计算了非iframe区域的高度，导致弹层被遮挡 by @F-jianchao in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11898
* fix: 修复接口报错时无法弹出预期的 msg 内容 by @Kerminate in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11901
* fix: 修复form 下面的弹窗执行事件动作后弹窗变成空白的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11896
* fix: 修复 crud 通过事件动作新增行无法选中问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11899
* feat: TooltipWrapper暗色模式下border去除 by @menglingz in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11905
* fix[editor]: input-table组件特定动作setValue的配置面板 行序号指定支持表达式输入 by @yangwei9012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11909
* feat: crud2的构建builder支持数据导出配置 by @hzh11012 in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11908
* feat: Table 优化大数据性能 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11915
* fix: form 里面的弹窗执行 form 事件动作后数据丢失的问题 by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11916
* Revert "feat: Table 优化大数据性能" by @2betop in https://github.com/baidu/amis/pull/11920
* fix: table开启
